headline: Cal State Monterey Bay end Cal State LA's winning run
dek: Cal State Monterey Bay held Cal State LA to a goalless draw, ending a run of six straight wins. Cal State LA have still to concede in seven matches this season, and Cal State San Bernardino, who won at Cal State San Marcos on the same day, are the only other unbeaten side in the conference.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's 27 goals are more than Stanislaus State and Cal State San Bernardino have scored together, and ten different players have shared them.

wire.line: Cal State East Bay have their first win of the season, away at Cal Poly Humboldt, after two draws and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result recorded, every one of them in August; the latest is Chico State's match with Yuba.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have won five and drawn two after winning at Cal State San Marcos, and have conceded three goals across them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UC Merced lost for the first time this season, at home to Fresno Pacific, after two wins and three draws.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn four of their eight matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored eight of Fresno Pacific's 27 goals.

last_match.line: Cal State Monterey Bay have drawn both of their conference matches; Cal State LA had won every match before this one.

next_match.line: Stanislaus State have drawn both of their conference matches; Cal State LA have yet to concede to anyone.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
